edits: Scaled 0.1 (MPFB units to metres); rotated to Blender frame (Z up, front +Y); feet on floor
Triangulated and Decimate collapse, ratio 0.22 (19158 verts to fit the 10k triangle budget)
Material slots by region (skin, hair, navy-charcoal coat, trousers, shoes), flat colours, no textures
Solid backpack box (VIS_daypack) on bone daypack, muted green-grey, not skinned
Armature of 24 joints named after the character contract (UE-style names, subset), rest pose A-like
Skin weights: inverse-distance to bone segments, top 4 bones per vertex (Blender heat weighting failed on the decimated mesh)
Clips idle (4.0 s), walk (1.0 s), run (0.6 s) authored procedurally with sinusoidal keyframes at 30 fps, in place, frame N equal to frame 0
No blink morphs, no face detail beyond the base mesh, no hair cards
